hypothesis: Sci-fi visual style and long-task capability converge when the TUI uses minimal high-contrast visual elements for status communication, designed for 'glance-back' moments rather than continuous monitoring.

candidates.oneLiner: Add token/cost/cache bar to existing TUI bottom
Model agent execution as plan/code/test/verify phases, TUI organized around phases
3-line summary bar for 2-second context recovery on return
Minimal mode + full cockpit mode, user toggles

extinctions.reason: Causal chain broken: seeing numbers does not equal capability improvement
salvagedTraits: token progress bar as sub-element of V3

extinctions.reason: Depends on user actively switching modes (unvalidated assumption)
salvagedTraits: minimal default concept → V3 collapsed state

survivors.advantage: Directly addresses users leaving and returning (validated by research)
Phase awareness helps users decide when to intervene

adapt.finalCandidate: V3+V2 fusion: V2 as data layer (PhaseTracker), V3 as display layer (SummaryBar)
adapt.convergenceInsight: Long-task TUI value is not 'show more info' but 'in the moment attention returns, convey critical state with minimal visual elements'

counterEvidence.premise1_users_look: ASSUMPTION - developers context-switch during 10+ min tasks. Design for glanceability not continuous monitoring.
counterEvidence.premise2_truecolor: STATUS - ~70-80% actual coverage due to tmux/SSH. Mandatory 256-color fallback.
counterEvidence.premise3_performance: FACT - Ink 6 has flicker risk. Limit live area, throttle updates.
counterEvidence.premise4_dashboard: CONVENTION - preference split. Only show ACTIONABLE metrics.
counterEvidence.premise5_cache_display: ASSUMPTION - cache hit rate not actionable for most users. Demote to /debug.

fragments.text: eDEX-UI's core visual: real-time data panels + cyberpunk palette on dark bg
Ink 6 Static component = write-once scrollback. All animation must be in live area only.
gradient-string outputs ANSI sequences compatible with Ink Text component
Braille sparklines (U+2800-28FF) give 2x resolution per character cell
Dashboard fatigue: when everything is highlighted, nothing is. htop succeeds because every element is actionable.
Context pressure is a threshold event (80%), not a continuous visualization need
Compaction as visible event: tell user what was PRESERVED, not just that it happened
